title: Kindergarten Social Studies — Rules That Help Us Learn Together
subject: Social Studies
description: Practice with questions on fairness, taking turns, safety, classroom.
creator: Teach Arcade

questions.question: Why do we walk inside a crowded hall?
Your class shares one ball. What is fair?
What should you do with borrowed classroom scissors when finished?
choices: put them in a friend's bag

questions.question: Another child is speaking to the class. What helps everyone hear?
You spill water on the floor. What can you do?
choices: tell an adult and help clean it up

questions.question: Which rule helps all children have a turn on the slide?
choices: save the slide for one person

questions.question: What should you do with a trash wrapper?
Why have a rule about keeping hands to yourself in line?
choices: to keep the line from moving

questions.question: A jar breaks at school. What should a child do first?
choices: pick up sharp pieces with bare hands

questions.question: Why raise your hand when your class uses that rule?
choices: so people can speak one at a time

questions.question: Your job is to pass out four books. What is doing your job?
choices: use them to block a doorway

questions.question: What helps keep a shared table ready for the next class?
Two children want one red marker. What can they agree to do?
choices: use it only when the other leaves school

questions.question: What should you do if you forget a rule?
choices: make up a rule for everyone
ask a trusted adult to explain it
tell others rules do not matter

questions.question: What should children do when the teacher asks the class to line up for a drill?
Why does the class put bags out of the main path?
Which action keeps a borrowed book ready for others?
choices: fold each page into a triangle

questions.question: Why do classroom rules apply to everyone?
choices: so only new students know the rules
so everyone knows what to expect

questions.question: An outdoor game has a boundary. What should you do when play goes past it?
choices: follow the rule for bringing play back in bounds

questions.question: What can you say when you bump someone by mistake?
choices: “You are not allowed to stand here.”
